source_name: NLB corporate governance - Dodatna razkritja (additional disclosures)
why_relevant: Slovenian-language governance disclosure page holding statutory 'additional disclosures' that sit outside the IR reports tree - e.g. governance statements, policies, statutory notices. Easy to miss if only the EN IR tree is crawled.

source_name: NLB Addiko takeover offer disclosure page (corporate action)
why_relevant: Dedicated disclosure hub for NLB's voluntary takeover offer for Addiko Bank AG - the single largest live SEE consolidation move by a Slovenian bank, with offer documents, ATA notices and regulatory milestones. Directly relevant to regional expansion and post-merger IT/integration demand.

source_name: NLB Issued Bonds / Dolžniški vrednostni papirji (MREL & senior issuance)
why_relevant: Bond documentation, final terms and issuance history reveal funding cost, MREL build-up and investor presentations aimed at debt investors, which often contain a distinct, more detailed risk/strategy narrative than equity decks.

source_name: NLB Ownership / Shareholder Structure page
why_relevant: Tracks the Republic of Slovenia stake, GDR share and free float. Ownership shifts are a leading indicator of governance and strategy change at the only listed Slovenian systemic bank.

source_name: Legacy NLB.si investor document archive (nlb.si/nlb/nlb-portal/slo/o-banki/vlagatelji/...)
why_relevant: Older Slovenian-language Pillar 3 and financial-report PDFs still resolve under the legacy nlb.si portal path rather than nlbgroup.com. Necessary for building a long back-series (pre-2023) and for Slovenian-language wording of risk disclosures.

source_name: financialreports.eu - NLB filings aggregator
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator indexing NLB filings and financial statements. Useful as a redundancy/monitoring layer and to detect filings quickly, but must be treated as secondary - always resolve back to the issuer or SEOnet original.

source_name: NLB Group investor relations contact desk (IR@nlb.si, Head of IR)
why_relevant: Named IR contact channel. Useful for resolving document ambiguity or requesting historical decks; also a stable indicator of IR-team continuity. Contact only through official channels and for legitimate research requests.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (SI) — Finančna poročila in dokumenti
why_relevant: Post-merger OTP banka (ex-Nova KBM + ex-SKB) is now the largest non-NLB bank in Slovenia; this hub carries annual reports, interim results and Pillar 3 razkritja for the combined entity.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (SI) — Sporočila za medije
why_relevant: Because OTP banka SI has no listed-equity IR function, the press room is the primary and often only trace of results announcements, system/IT migration milestones, branch and channel changes, and vendor-visible projects.

source_name: SKB banka d.d. — annual reports / press (legacy, merged into OTP banka)
why_relevant: SKB was deleted from the Bank of Slovenia supervised register on 22.8.2024 after merging into OTP; the legacy PDF archive (letno poročilo 2008–2023) remains the historical baseline for SKB's pre-merger tech and cost base.

source_name: Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d. (Koper) — letna poročila in razkritja (PDF library)
why_relevant: Publishes a full local annual report series plus standalone CRR Part 8 'Razkritja' PDFs; the standalone Pillar 3 documents are the richest structured view of the bank's risk and operating profile absent an IR function.

source_name: UniCredit Banka Slovenija d.d. — Disclosures (Razkritja) document store
why_relevant: Publishes both annual reports and quarterly/annual CRR Pillar 3 razkritja as PDFs under a stable /content/dam/ path; quarterly cadence makes it one of the higher-frequency disclosure surfaces in this cell.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Slovenia — Press Releases
why_relevant: Local press room, published in both SL and EN; announcements of product/channel launches and local results are the only visible trace of Slovenian projects that never reach a public tender portal.

source_name: Addiko Bank d.d. Slovenija — Letna poročila (Tisk in publikacije)
why_relevant: Local subsidiary annual report series (2016–) in Slovenian; complements the listed parent's group reporting with entity-level Slovenian numbers and governance detail.

source_name: Addiko Bank d.d. Slovenija — Razkritja (Pillar 3 / CRR disclosures)
why_relevant: Dedicated disclosures page for the Slovenian entity; separates regulatory CRR razkritja from the narrative annual report.

source_name: Addiko Bank AG (Vienna) — Investor Relations / Financial Reports
why_relevant: The only listed parent in this cell (VSE: ADKO). Group results presentations and reports break out Slovenia as a country segment with volumes, NPE and channel/digital commentary — the richest quantified view of Addiko SI available.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. — Letna poročila in dodatna razkritja
why_relevant: Erste/Steiermärkische-owned Slovenian bank; publishes CRR disclosures partly inside the annual report and partly as 'dodatna razkritja' by article. Approval status of the latest year is stated on-page, useful for timing collection.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. — Novice (news)
why_relevant: Slovenian-language news feed; the bank's only regular announcement channel for product, channel and partnership moves.

source_name: Gorenjska banka d.d. Kranj — Letna poročila in razkritja dodatnih informacij
why_relevant: AIK/Agri Europe-owned bank with no listed equity in SI; this page is the consolidated annual report + additional-disclosure surface, including a standalone governance disclosure PDF.

source_name: Gorenjska banka — Sporočila za javnost
why_relevant: Category feed of the bank's own press statements; particularly load-bearing given the ongoing ownership-suitability scrutiny of AIK banka, where the bank's own statements and the regulator's diverge.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica d.d. — Letna poročila / Za vlagatelje
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian savings bank and a fast-growing domestic player; maintains an investor-style section (shares are widely held) with annual reports, AGM notices and additional disclosures.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica — Obvestila (notices)
why_relevant: Statutory-style notice feed (AGM convocations, capital actions, results announcements) — the functional equivalent of regulated announcements for an unlisted but widely-held institution.

source_name: Deželna banka Slovenije d.d. — Javne objave in finančna poročila
why_relevant: DBS publishes annual reports, unaudited interim results and a 'letni dokument objavljenih informacij' (annual document of published information) — a securities-law artefact that indexes everything else it published that year, making it an efficient pointer into its own disclosure trail.

source_name: Banka Slovenije — Finančne in nadzorniške informacije od kreditnih institucij (supervisory statistics)
why_relevant: FINREP/COREP-derived per-institution and sector aggregates give a comparable quantitative baseline for banks in this cell whose own reporting is narrative-heavy and annual-only.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — annual report and member directory
why_relevant: The banking association's annual report enumerates member banks and carries sector-level macro and banking indicators; the membership list is the cleanest single actor map for this cell (it names every bank and savings bank in scope plus adjacent ones like Hranilnica Lon and Primorska hranilnica Vipava).

source_name: Primorska hranilnica Vipava — letna poročila in razkritja
why_relevant: Smallest Slovenian credit institution (~EUR 30m total assets); adjacent to but consistent with this cell's 'savings banks' scope. Publishes annual reports and maintains Razkritja / Skupščine / Letna poročila sections. Useful as the floor case for what minimum-viable disclosure looks like in SI.

source_name: Društvo Mali delničarji Slovenije (skupaj.si / malidelnicarji.com) — AGM calendar and issuer pages
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association that tracks AGMs of unlisted Slovenian issuers including DBS and Primorska hranilnica, with dated agenda summaries (management compensation, audit outcomes, dividends). It surfaces AGM material for banks with no IR page, and dates future meetings in advance.

source_name: Bizi.si / eBonitete / CompanyWall — Slovenian company-data aggregators
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators of AJPES filings and register data. Fastest way to get entity identifiers, ownership chains, and headline financials for banks and their non-bank subsidiaries without an AJPES session; useful for detecting subsidiaries the banks do not discuss.
